entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: ¶Truly, my eye has seen all this, word of it has come to my ear, and I have knowledge of it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: The same things are in my mind as in yours; I am equal to you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: But I would have talk with the Ruler of all, and my desire is to have an argument with God.

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: But you put a false face on things; all your attempts to put things right are of no value.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: If only you would keep quiet, it would be a sign of wisdom!

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Give ear to the argument of my mouth, and take note of the words of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Will you say in God's name what is not right, and put false words into his mouth?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will you have respect for God's person in this cause, and put yourselves forward as his supporters?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Will it be good for you to be searched out by him, or have you the thought that he may be guided into error like a man?

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will certainly put you right, if you have respect for persons in secret.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Will not his glory put you in fear, so that your hearts will be overcome before him?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your wise sayings are only dust, and your strong places are only earth.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: ¶Keep quiet, and let me say what is in my mind, whatever may come to me.

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: I will take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Truly, he will put an end to me; I have no hope; but I will not give way in argument before him;

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: And that will be my salvation, for an evil-doer would not come before him,

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Give ear with care to my words, and keep what I say in your minds.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: See now, I have put my cause in order, and I am certain that I will be seen to be right.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Is any one able to take up the argument against me? If so, I would keep quiet and give up my breath.

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: Only two things do not do to me, then I will come before your face:

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Take your hand far away from me; and let me not be overcome by fear of you.

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then at the sound of your voice I will give answer; or let me put forward my cause for you to give me an answer.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: ¶What is the number of my evil-doings and my sins? give me knowledge of them.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Why is your face veiled from me, as if I was numbered among your haters?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Will you be hard on a leaf in flight before the wind? will you make a dry stem go more quickly on its way?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For you put bitter things on record against me, and send punishment on me for the sins of my early years;

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: And you put chains on my feet, watching all my ways, and making a limit for my steps;

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: Though a man comes to nothing like a bit of dead wood, or like a robe which has become food for the worm.
